prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready enemy sprite for Brine Against the World. Reference is STYLE ONLY, do not copy its anatomy. Bold hand-inked comic cartoon with chunky mascot proportions, expressive simple eyes, thick near-black outlines, restrained flat cel shadows, occasional purposeful scuffs. A SALT PORTER: a squat living salt sack creature with a folded canvas mouth, two stubby bootlike feet, exactly two thick arms, a tiny wooden scoop held low in the near hand, a lopsided salt-crystal shoulder. Silhouette triangular and soft, warm ivory canvas, ochre seams, muted olive limbs. Full body, three-quarter SIDE VIEW FACING LEFT, ready to attack the player on its left, centered with clear space around all edges. Grounded standing pose, hands separated from torso so code animation reads. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadow. Not Brine, not a crab, no eyestalks. No lettering, symbols, plus signs, UI, labels, badges, glow, gradients, 3D plastic, generic fantasy armor, floating particles or additional characters. Clear silhouette readable at 110px tall. Save the output as a local PNG and report its path.

PIPE PILFER: a wiry blue-gray eel creature curled through a short bent brass drainpipe which is its torso. Long blunt eel head with underbite extends left from pipe mouth; exactly two short webbed feet under the pipe and a thick hooked tail curling upward on right. NO arms, NO humanoid body, NO handheld weapon. An integral pipe muzzle on the chest points left to spit three small scrap pellets. Distinct horizontal S-shaped silhouette, old brass, petrol blue skin, ivory teeth.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE enemy sprite for Brine Against the World in bold ink comic cartoon style: MUD SKIPPER, a squat shovel-snouted mudfish, NOT humanoid, wedge-shaped slate olive head with one blunt spade-shaped snout facing LEFT, two tiny close-set eyes flush in head, broad flattened body, exactly two muscular front walking fins and a single tapering curled tail at right. A cracked terracotta drain collar around midbody. NO eyestalks, arms, armor, held tools, gun, teeth smile or particles. Use case: stylized-concept. ONE unique boss sprite for Brine Against the World. A massive living harbor WINCH: low wide iron drum body in desaturated navy, rope coiled around the drum, a small heavy square head perched on top with narrow ivory eyes looking LEFT, exactly TWO huge hinged pile-driver forearms with flat blunt hammer fists, exactly TWO short boot-shaped metal feet. One shoulder higher than the other. No held weapons, no extra limbs, no valve wheel on head, no eyestalks, not Brine. Three-quarter side view facing LEFT, attack-ready arms apart from torso, full body centered with 10% margins. Bold hand-inked comic mascot style matching reference linework only, flat cel shadows and a few purposeful rust chips, warm ochre rope, muted blue iron, thick nearblack outlines. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no text/symbols/plus signs, no glows, no generic fantasy details, no 3D plastic. Powerful broad silhouette at 140px tall.

Precise background extraction edit. Keep this exact mudfish character and every opaque body detail unchanged. REMOVE the soft colored outer glow and hazy shadow around it completely. Outside the crisp black ink contour must be 100% alpha zero, including between fins and tail. No floor, no shadow, no halo, no new marks. Return the exact full character as a clean transparent game sprite.

Use case: illustration-story. Production panoramic background layer for a SIDE-SCROLLING bold comic RPG, Brine Against the World. Wide landscape 2:1 composition. A weather-beaten tidal industrial harbor with distant crooked cranes, low salt warehouses, tide towers, long seawall arches, thin cables and tiny moored hulls. Pale warm cream clouded sky occupies upper half, muted sea-green water lower half. Horizon straight and horizontal, no vanishing road, no main focal centerpiece, no character or UI. Illustrate real purposeful details: stacked stone footings, rust-streaked roof seams, pipe junctions, weathered piling caps. Bold hand-inked contours, flat editorial comic cel shadows, limited ink hatching, subtle paper grain, NOT vector geometry, not 3D, not painterly fog, no glow, no text, signs, letters, badges or symbols. Low contrast distant objects, deep teal silhouettes with muted clay accents. Left and right edges contain matching quiet sky/water and no tall cropped landmark so horizontal repeating works. Fill the image edge-to-edge.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE wide transparent foreground/midground parallax layer for a 2D sidescroller in bold hand-inked comic style. 2:1 landscape. A long horizontal strip of old working harbor quay: clusters of leaning timber posts, rope coils, battered ochre bollards, sea-green pipe elbows, low stacked crate piles, suspended fishing nets, one low patched corrugated awning, little barnacles along worn stonework. Objects connected by a low seawall running the entire bottom width. Tallest object no more than half image height. All objects concentrated LOWER HALF, upper HALF genuinely transparent, including gaps between poles and ropes. No sky, no water, no ground plane behind the layer, no backdrop shadow. Detailed purposeful drawn construction, heavy nearblack outlines, flat cel shadows, warm dark umber foreground, rust clay/copper accents, muted moss. No characters, lettering, plus signs, glows, generic fantasy ruins. Keep central battle zone open; detail distributed unevenly in modest clusters, quiet small stonework at both outer edges for repeating. Full width layer.

Use case: illustration-story. Production horizontally repeating walking-ground texture for a bold hand-inked comic 2D sidescroller, wide landscape 3:1 strip. A straight level old harbor deck seen slightly from above, chunky weathered warm gray-brown horizontal timber planks, purposeful cracks and large nailheads, occasional shallow salt stains, two recessed metal drain grates, patched short iron brace strips. Top edge is a continuous straight dark timber lip. No perspective convergence or diagonal road, no horizon, no sky, no characters, no raised objects, no text or symbols. Entire image filled with deck wood to every edge. Muted warm umber and parchment grays, dark ink outlines and flat cel shadows with sparse hand hatching. High detail but quiet large shapes so characters remain readable. Left and right edges have matching horizontal plank rows for repeated scrolling. No gradients, glow, photorealism or 3D.
